scope: Static initial oil and free gas, not recoverable reserves or production forecast

assumptions: PUBLIC DEMO ONLY: static sensitivity benchmark, not Norne reserves or simulator initialization
Source coordinates are metres and positive depth; canonical Z is negative source depth; CRS/datum are unverified
Explicit demo fluid assumptions: Sw=0.25, Bo=1.2 rm3/sm3, Bg=0.005 rm3/sm3, oil-zone Sg=0, gas-zone So=0.05
Only EQLNUM 1 and 3 are selected for the regional calculation; the original ACTNUM is preserved
QC findings in other regions remain visible; no cells are silently repaired or removed

metric_definitions.GRV: Full active selected region bulk volume m3
metric_definitions.GRV_oil_interval: Bulk above OWC and below GOC when provided, m3
metric_definitions.NetRockVolume: Oil interval bulk times NTG, m3
metric_definitions.PV: Oil interval net pore volume, m3
metric_definitions.HCPV: Oil interval pore volume times (1-Sw-Sg_oil), m3
metric_definitions.STOIIP: Initial oil HCPV/Bo, standard m3; not recoverable reserves
metric_definitions.TotalPV: Whole selected region net pore volume, m3
metric_definitions.GasPV: Gas interval net pore volume, m3
metric_definitions.GasHCPV: Gas interval pore volume times (1-Sw-So_gas), m3
metric_definitions.GIIP: Free-gas GasHCPV/Bg, standard m3; excludes dissolved gas

limitations: Six-tetrahedron cell geometry convention; Z is positive upward
Saturation-height functions are evaluated at the mean corner height of each selected cell
Polygon selection, when requested, keeps whole cells by mean corner XY; no polygon fractional clipping
Free-gas GIIP excludes dissolved gas; all residual phase saturations and Bo/Bg are explicit user inputs
